summaryZh: Ayyagari Lab 研究遗传性视网膜和黄斑营养不良的致病基因、分子通路与治疗靶点。研究利用全基因组或外显子分析、单细胞基因组学、患者来源干细胞及类器官和基因工程动物模型。
researchQuestions: 哪些基因导致或参与遗传性视网膜病变？
哪些分子通路和机制导致遗传性视网膜及黄斑营养不良？
methods: 全基因组与外显子测序
患者来源干细胞与类器官

evidence.quote: Ayyagari Lab Retinal Molecular Genetics Laboratory
Our laboratory is based at the Shiley Eye Institute at UCSD.
We use molecular genetics and cell biology approaches to understand the mechanisms involved in causing inherited retinal and macular dystrophies.
whole exome sequencing (WES), whole genome sequencing (WGS) and single cell genomics.
reprogramming blood cells to stem cells using patient’s blood and differentiating them to desired cell types and organoids.
The focus of the research studies in Ayyagari lab is finding causative genes or elusive genes involved in the retinal pathologies and identify therapeutic targets.
